design.name: 变脸傩巫
design.brief: A Nuo exorcist shaman (傩巫) of the fire god's altar, the support who drives other fiends with a fire Nuo dance and changes faces like Sichuan-opera face-changing (变脸): a lean dancer about 1.8 m tall wearing a big carved wooden Nuo mask (傩面) that covers the whole face — bulging round eyes, flared nostrils, a tusked grin, painted bold vermilion red with black and gold, its eyes glowing lava orange (the mask is the weak spot) — a crown of long stiff pheasant tail feathers and red cloth streamers, a layered vermilion and black ritual robe with wide flaring sleeves, a rope belt with small bronze bells and paper charms, bare forearms with bronze bangles, bare feet with ankle bells. Hands with a clearly separate thumb and four fingers, empty. Wild, theatrical and ritual.
design.weapon: no weapon: mid-dance, one wide sleeve sweeping across the mask to change its face, the other hand raised high with the fingers spread, a jet of fire spat from the mask's mouth
design.style_note: Stylization: cartoon game proportions in the same family as the desert and frost rosters (jerboa soldier, fire rat, sancai tomb beast, golden snub-nosed monkey): chunky simplified masses, oversized heads and hands or paws, toy-like readable forms with clean bevelled edges. Iron, basalt and bronze as a few big faceted plates with sparse painted wear; lava and fire painted as OPAQUE glowing cracks, seams and solid sculpted flame shapes (never transparent fire, smoke or particles); fur, hair and feathers as a few large carved clumps. The mask is a solid carved wooden object worn on the face.
design.turnaround_pose: standing upright, BOTH ARMS IN THE SAME MIRRORED A-POSE about 35 degrees away from the body, elbows slightly bent, both hands open and EMPTY with the fingers slightly spread; the wide sleeves as thick simple shapes ending above the wrists so both hands are fully visible; legs straight, feet a little apart; the red Nuo mask worn on the face facing straight ahead with the eyes painted opaque glowing orange (no halo); the feather crown upright and symmetric; streamers hanging straight down; no fire
design.turnaround_digits: each hand with a separate thumb and four fingers, each bare foot with five toes, clearly countable; the feather crown tips fully inside the frame.
